guidance.bestFor: Plain text levels split by the default chevron, with no icons, menus or custom styling

whenNotToUse.when: Deep paths whose hidden middle levels open from a menu

guidance.bestFor: Middle levels folded into an ellipsis button that opens a dropdown of the hidden pages
agentNotes: The 3 `DropdownMenuItem` rows carry no `href`, so choosing one goes nowhere; render each as a link to its hidden page

guidance.bestFor: Crumbs that render a caller supplied anchor element, the place to swap in your router's link
agentNotes: Both parent crumbs hand a plain `a` to `BreadcrumbLink`, not a Next.js link despite the title; swap in your router's link component

name: c-breadcrumb-4
title: Breadcrumb with a custom slash separator
label: Slash Separator
description: Breadcrumb with a custom slash separator

guidance.bestFor: Slash characters between levels in place of the default chevron, on an otherwise plain trail

name: c-breadcrumb-5
title: Breadcrumb with icons for each item
label: Item Icons
description: Breadcrumb with icons for each item

guidance.bestFor: A leading icon on every level including the current page, laid out beside each label

name: c-breadcrumb-6
title: Breadcrumb with ellipsis for long paths
label: Static Ellipsis
description: Breadcrumb with ellipsis for long paths

guidance.bestFor: A static ellipsis standing in for skipped middle levels, with no menu or link behind it
agentNotes: `BreadcrumbEllipsis` is `aria-hidden`, so screen readers skip the gap and never learn that levels are hidden

whenNotToUse.when: Skipped levels that must stay reachable by mouse and keyboard

guidance.bestFor: Team and user levels led by small avatar images with initials fallbacks, ending on a plain current page
agentNotes: Each `AvatarImage` loads a github.com picture; point every `src` at your own team and user images

whenNotToUse.when: Levels that also need a second line, such as an email or a file name

guidance.bestFor: Double chevron icons passed into each separator in place of the single default one
A trail on a padded Card surface, opening with a home icon and ending on a semibold current page
A trail inside a ReUI Frame panel rather than a Card, with a home icon, tight padding and a semibold last level

name: c-breadcrumb-11
title: Breadcrumb items containing badge with count
label: Count Badge
description: Breadcrumb items containing badge with count

guidance.bestFor: A rounded count badge inside a parent level, here a total of 3 beside the Inbox folder of a mail path
agentNotes: The 3 inside `Badge` is a fixed sample count; bind it to the live count of the Inbox folder

name: c-breadcrumb-12
title: Breadcrumb starting with home icon item
label: Home Icon Button
description: Breadcrumb starting with home icon item

guidance.bestFor: A square outline icon button as the home level, with its label kept for screen readers only
agentNotes: The Home crumb renders as a native `Button` with no link behind it, so it never navigates; style a real anchor with the button variants

whenNotToUse.when: An icon beside the label on every level of the path

guidance.bestFor: A short faded bar between levels, drawn by a small local component rather than a character or icon
Every level as a small button pairing an icon with its label, ghost for parent pages and filled secondary for the current one
agentNotes: Home and Workspace render as a native `Button`, not a link, so they never navigate; style real anchors with the button variants
`BreadcrumbPage` wraps a focusable `Button`, a control nested in a disabled link role; style the page text itself rather than nesting it

name: c-breadcrumb-15
title: Breadcrumb with project, user and document info
label: Project & Document
description: Breadcrumb with project, user and document info

guidance.bestFor: Two line levels pairing an avatar or tinted file tile with a name above a muted email or file name
agentNotes: The first `BreadcrumbLink` holds only an `Avatar` with no text, so it has no reliable accessible name; add an sr-only label
Swap the github.com `AvatarImage` sources and the sample name, email and agents.md file for real records
